properties.notes: Site of a former petrol station, commercial garage and an associated bungalow. An application for construction of 8 homes was permitted in 2006 (CM/06/D/395). The site was vacant at the time of this proposal, demolition and clearance having already taken place. Development of 8 dwellings completed in 2019/20.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.site-address: Garage Site, Main Street, Red Row
